user.title: almanac
user.description: almanac schedules what happens and shows you when. There is nothing to configure here — schedules and day sets are created afterwards.

abort.single_instance_allowed: almanac is already set up. Schedules are items inside it, not separate installations.

run_now.name: Run now
run_now.description: Run a schedule, or one rule in it, straight away — without waiting for its anchor and without moving it.

schedule_id.name: Schedule
schedule_id.description: The schedule to run. Give this or an almanac entity to act on.

rule_id.name: Rule
rule_id.description: One rule inside the schedule. Leave empty to run every rule.

bypass_conditions.name: Ignore conditions
bypass_conditions.description: Run even where the rule's conditions are not met. Off by default: a rule whose conditions are false is recorded as skipped.
